```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tseries)
library(urca)
library(vars)

# 1. IMPORT DATA
data <- read_excel("D:/STIS/ARW/UAS/DATA UAS_222413767.xlsx", sheet = "no2")
inflasi <- as.numeric(data$inflasi)
rate    <- as.numeric(data$bunga)
kurs    <- as.numeric(data$kurs)

cat("Observasi :", nrow(data), "\n")
cat("Periode   :", format(min(data$periode), "%Y-%m"), "s.d.", format(max(data$periode), "%Y-%m"), "\n")

# 2. UJI STASIONERITAS
uji <- function(x, nama){
  adf0 <- ur.df(x, type="trend", lags=12, selectlags="AIC")
  adf1 <- ur.df(diff(x), type="drift", lags=12, selectlags="AIC")
  
  data.frame(
    Variabel = c(paste(nama,"Level"), paste(nama,"First Difference")),
    ADF_Stat = c(adf0@teststat[1], adf1@teststat[1]),
    ADF_CV5  = c(adf0@cval[1,"5pct"], adf1@cval[1,"5pct"]),
    PP_p     = suppressWarnings(c(
      pp.test(x)$p.value,
      pp.test(diff(x))$p.value
    )),
    KPSS_p   = suppressWarnings(c(
      kpss.test(x, null="Trend")$p.value,
      kpss.test(diff(x), null="Level")$p.value
    ))
  )
}

stasioneritas <- rbind(
  uji(inflasi, "Inflasi"),
  uji(rate, "Suku Bunga"),
  uji(kurs, "Kurs")
)

# UJI STASIONERITAS
stasioneritas[, -1] <- round(stasioneritas[, -1], 4)
print(stasioneritas, row.names=FALSE)

# 3. UJI KOINTEGRASI
Z <- cbind(Suku_Bunga=rate, Kurs=kurs)

lag_koint <- VARselect(Z, lag.max=12, type="const")
K <- max(2, as.integer(lag_koint$selection["AIC(n)"]))

# LAG KOINTEGRASI
print(lag_koint$selection)
cat("Lag terpilih :", K, "\n")
jo <- ca.jo(
  Z,
  type="trace",
  ecdet="const",
  K=K,
  spec="transitory"
)

# UJI KOINTEGRASI JOHANSEN
print(summary(jo))

# 4. DATA STASIONER UNTUK VAR
Y <- na.omit(data.frame(
  Inflasi      = inflasi,
  dSuku_Bunga  = c(NA, diff(rate)),
  dKurs        = c(NA, diff(kurs))
))

# 5. LAG OPTIMAL VAR
lag_var <- VARselect(Y, lag.max=12, type="const")
p <- as.integer(lag_var$selection["AIC(n)"])

# LAG OPTIMAL VAR
print(lag_var$selection)
cat("Lag VAR:", p, "\n")

# 6. ESTIMASI VAR
var_model <- VAR(Y, p=p, type="const")
print(summary(var_model))

# 7. STABILITAS
akar <- roots(var_model, modulus=TRUE)

# STABILITAS VAR
print(round(akar, 4))
cat("Root maksimum :", round(max(akar), 4), "\n")

# 8. DIAGNOSTIK
# A. Uji Autokorelasi (Portmanteau Test) - H0: Tidak ada autokorelasi
print(serial.test(var_model, lags.pt=12, type="PT.asymptotic"))
# B. Uji Normalitas (Jarque-Bera) - H0: Residual berdistribusi normal
print(normality.test(var_model, multivariate.only=TRUE))
# C. Uji Heteroskedastisitas (ARCH-LM) - H0: Varians residual konstan
print(arch.test(var_model, lags.multi=5, multivariate.only=TRUE))

# 9. GRANGER CAUSALITY
# GRANGER INFLASI
print(causality(var_model, cause="Inflasi")$Granger)
# GRANGER SUKU BUNGA
print(causality(var_model, cause="dSuku_Bunga")$Granger)
# GRANGER KURS
print(causality(var_model, cause="dKurs")$Granger)

# 10. IMPULSE RESPONSE FUNCTION
set.seed(123)

IRF_inflasi <- irf(
  var_model, impulse="Inflasi",
  response=colnames(Y),
  n.ahead=12, boot=TRUE, runs=500, ci=0.95
)
IRF_rate <- irf(
  var_model, impulse="dSuku_Bunga",
  response=colnames(Y),
  n.ahead=12, boot=TRUE, runs=500, ci=0.95
)
IRF_kurs <- irf(
  var_model, impulse="dKurs",
  response=colnames(Y),
  n.ahead=12, boot=TRUE, runs=500, ci=0.95
)
# IRF SHOCK INFLASI
print(round(IRF_inflasi$irf$Inflasi, 4))
# IRF SHOCK SUKU BUNGA
print(round(IRF_rate$irf$dSuku_Bunga, 4))
# IRF SHOCK KURS
print(round(IRF_kurs$irf$dKurs, 4))

par(mfrow = c(3, 3), mar = c(3, 4, 3, 1))
for (x in list(IRF_inflasi, IRF_rate, IRF_kurs)) {
  imp <- names(x$irf)
  for (res in colnames(Y)) {
    m  <- x$irf[[imp]][, res]
    lo <- x$Lower[[imp]][, res]
    up <- x$Upper[[imp]][, res]
    plot(0:12, m, type = "l", lwd = 2, ylim = range(lo, up, 0),
         main = paste("Shock", imp, "->", res), xlab = "", ylab = "", cex.main = 0.9)
    lines(0:12, lo, lty = 2, col = "red")
    lines(0:12, up, lty = 2, col = "red")
    abline(h = 0, col = "grey40")
  }
}
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
